records.name: Rage Saucer
records.effect: Teleporting multi-hit kick/punch rush ending in a powerful kick.

records.name: Brainwash Attack
records.effect: Creates dark-energy bubbles that immobilize targets; boss version can brainwash the trapped player.

records.name: Light of Justice
records.effect: Charged mouth-fired energy beam with Super Armor.

records.name: Instant Charge
records.effect: Rapidly charges Ki and automatically stops after six bars; includes a brief teleporting activation.

notes: These four were absent from docs/data/skills.json before this batch. Each is explicitly identified by Xenoverse 2 documentation as a Super Skill and its category. Rage Saucer is a Strike Super; Brainwash Attack and Instant Charge are Other Supers; Light of Justice is a Ki Blast Super. Raid/Crystal Raid restrictions are preserved as CaC-unavailable rather than treated as ordinary unlockable skills.
